title: FinResearchOps thesis case v24: refused final-report numbers hidden instead of discarding the report

forward_calculations.description: Deterministic results from the exact forward_draft; reopened and compared by the same calculator. No economic or source certification.

retry_run_id.description: The retry call's run id; null only for a NUMBER_REPAIR row whose call was never sent (protocol 24: number_masking then records the masking).

oneOf.description: Every problem proven from the failed call, in this order; an unknown reference may be an empty string.

number_masking.description: Protocol 24: when the final report is refused only for unbound numbers and the sentence repair is unavailable or does not pass, each refused sentence keeps its words and citations and only the numerals the contract refuses become the mark 〔数值待核〕 (mode numbers); when hiding every numeral is still refused, the whole sentence becomes one mark followed by its citations (mode sentence). The reader derives the same masking from the saved answer. A masked Case is PARTIAL.

recommendation.description: Research stance from this analysis under its stated assumptions. When the basis is thin, say so in the rationale instead of withholding a rating; Hold means a supported neutral view.
recommendation.title: Recommendation

strategic_actions.description: Conditional next steps; do not invent holdings or personal risk constraints.
strategic_actions.title: Strategic Actions

ResearchEvaluation.description: Complete JSON response containing plan, assessments and valuation_basis_and_gaps.
ResearchEvaluation.title: ResearchEvaluation

ExecutionReview.description: Complete JSON execution review, not a free-text transaction report.
ExecutionReview.title: ExecutionReview

belief_id.description: D1, D2, ... in order; these are this independent draft's beliefs.
belief_id.title: Belief Id

IndependentAssessment.description: Source-only beliefs first, then a compact initial stance; no duplicate financial report.
IndependentAssessment.title: IndependentAssessment

value.description: Numeric input, or null when unavailable. Ratios are fractions, not percentage points. Do not use zero for unknown.
value.title: Value

reason.description: Explain the input, historical anchor and forward change; a cited historical number does not certify a forecast.
reason.title: Reason

drivers.description: Business mechanism linking observed activity to the annual forecast; do not merely apply symmetric percentage changes.
drivers.title: Drivers

net_nonoperating_income.description: Signed total net interest, investment, FX and other pretax non-operating income, in millions of reporting currency.

diluted_ordinary_shares.description: Millions of diluted ordinary shares for this forecast period, not millions of ADS.

non_working_capital_adjustments.description: Signed profit-to-CFO adjustments before changes in operating assets/liabilities, including noncash items. CFO minus net income ALSO includes operating asset/liability cash effects and cannot be used as this subtotal.

operating_asset_liability_cash_effect.description: Signed cash-flow effects of changes in operating assets/liabilities, including tax balances where reported. This is not a balance-sheet change or necessarily strict valuation NWC; cash release is positive, use is negative.

cash_capex.description: Positive cash purchases of PPE/software and intangibles/content; deducted once. Do not claim maintenance capex is un-deducted after including these purchases.

fx_reporting_per_price_currency.description: Units of reporting currency for ONE unit of quote currency, e.g. CNY per USD. Explicit FX assumption for the valuation date.

exit_pe.description: Optional annual parent-earnings exit multiple. Justify reference, comparability and risks; null if no defensible basis. A multiple is not a fact or automatically fair value.

cash_dividend_per_traded_unit.description: Cumulative cash dividend per share/ADS over the holding horizon, in quote currency; not a buyback amount or annualized yield.

valuation_reasoning.description: Economic argument for the multiple or why no multiple is defensible; separate rerating from earnings growth. Do not fit inputs to current price.
valuation_reasoning.title: Valuation Reasoning

UnderwritingDraft.description: Business-driven forecast inputs; a calculator, not this model, performs the arithmetic.

business_model.description: Explain applicability of a non-financial operating-company earnings bridge. Do not force this template onto banks or loss-making early-stage businesses.
business_model.title: Business Model

earnings_basis.description: Annual earnings denominator relative to valuation date: trailing ends on that date, forward starts then or next day, fiscal_year uses explicit reporting-year dates and must explain comparability.
earnings_basis.title: Earnings Basis

forecast_end.description: End of the annual earnings/cash period used at valuation; show any actual/forecast blend in limitations.
forecast_end.title: Forecast End

shares_per_traded_unit.description: Ordinary shares represented by one quoted unit; 1 for ordinary shares, the source-supported ADS ratio for ADRs.

scenarios.description: Usually 2-3 distinct business paths. Empty only when the economic template cannot responsibly be applied; explain and still deliver qualitative research.
scenarios.title: Scenarios

UnderwritingDraft.title: UnderwritingDraft

value.description: Absolute nonnegative amount in millions, or null. Never copy a statement's deduction minus sign into this amount.
value.title: Value

reason.description: Explain the input, historical anchor and forward change; a cited historical number does not certify a forecast.
reason.title: Reason

nature.description: Economic nature: profit attributable to outside owners is deducted; their loss is added back. A statement may print a PROFIT deduction in parentheses; parentheses do not make it a loss.
nature.title: Nature

rating.description: Source-only research stance; use REVIEW when the price judgment lacks a defensible basis, not Hold as a placeholder.
rating.title: Rating

executive_summary.description: One concise reason grounded in the beliefs above. No second investment thesis or target-price essay.
executive_summary.title: Executive Summary

scenario_id.description: Null only for common market_price or shares_per_traded_unit.
scenario_id.title: Scenario Id

expected_before.description: Copy the proposed input VALUE exactly, not a historical source value. For NCI use its proposed nature and amount.value.
expected_before.title: Expected Before

replacement.description: Complete corrected assumption including reason and evidence_refs; NCI is a complete nature+amount object. Unknown uses value:null, never guessed zero.
replacement.title: Replacement

changes.description: Only justified changes. Empty is valid; do not redraw all forecasts or fit inputs to a desired price/rating.
changes.title: Changes

text.description: Concise economic explanation. Refer to forward quantities through metrics; do not retype forecast amounts/ratios, create a new target, or repeat the table. Historical claims still need source support. The model's answer keeps the frozen stage schema's limit (2400 characters); a protocol 24 masked report may exceed it by its pending marks.
text.title: Text

evidence_refs.description: Usually omit: program derives sources from inline evidence-block references.
evidence_refs.title: Evidence Refs

metrics.description: Usually omit: program derives metrics from inline references. No numeric values or labels.
metrics.title: Metrics

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The model's answer keeps the frozen stage schema's limit; a protocol 24 masked report may exceed it by its pending marks.

what_changes_the_view.title: What Changes The View
what_changes_the_view.description: The model's answer keeps the frozen stage schema's limit; a protocol 24 masked report may exceed it by its pending marks.

metrics.description: Optional extra metric selections; inline selections are derived automatically.
metrics.title: Metrics

rating.description: Research conclusion under this report's scenarios and assumptions, not a certified fair value. Missing consensus, comparables or valuation history lowers confidence; it never withholds the rating.
rating.title: Rating

confidence.description: How firmly the cited evidence supports the rating.
confidence.title: Confidence

RuleRating.description: Protocol 23 reference rating recomputed from the saved scenario calculations: each scenario's return to the valuation date (with dividends when stated), annualized over the research horizon, weighted equally and rounded to 0.01%; Buy from +20%, Overweight from +5%, Hold between -5% and +5%, Underweight from -20% to -5%, Sell at -20% or below. Not a fair value.

expected_return.description: Annualized over horizon_months, rounded to 4 decimal places; the rating bands this value.
